description: This file defines a Java interface 'CustomerOptionSetDao' for data access operations related to 'CustomerOptionSet' entities, including methods to retrieve sets by option ID, store, language, and specific IDs.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDao
classes.description: A Java interface extending generic DAO to handle 'CustomerOptionSet' entities, providing methods for retrieving sets based on various identifiers.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet objects by option ID within a store context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet objects for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific CustomerOptionSet by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet objects by option value ID within a store context.
